name: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited
about: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited engages in design, development, and marketing of computer software in India and internationally. Its products include Access Genie, an AIoT-powered security response platform; BluHawk, a threat hunting solution; BluTact, a mobile device management platform; BluHealth, an AI-enabled healthcare screener and nano-bio sterilizer; EduGenie, an AI-based learning management system; and Blura, an automated news aggregation solution. The company offers managed IT solutions, including network monitoring and maintenance, server administration, desktop and mobile device support, data backup and recovery, security and compliance, and cloud and IT consulting services. It also provides security operations center services, such as 24/7 monitoring, incident detection and response, security device management, threat intelligence integration, vulnerability management, and security reporting and compliance services. In addition, the company offers cloud mitigation and software architecture services. The company was formerly known as Adithya Aquaculture Limited and changed its name to Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited in November 2015. Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
